name: sonic
description: epocanvas sonic Music Cloud Platform & Aggregation Gateway

scripts.build: pnpm --dir player build && node scripts/write-release-manifest.mjs && node scripts/copy-dist.mjs
scripts.build:engine: esbuild server/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=dist-server/index.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.lint: npm run lint:theme && pnpm --dir player run lint
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && jiti scripts/test-sonic-gateway.mjs && jiti scripts/test-auth-compatibility.mjs && jiti scripts/test-cover-gateway.mjs && jiti scripts/test-local-engine-and-degradation.mjs && pnpm --dir player exec vitest run --root .. tests/security-route-hardening.test.ts tests/security.test.ts tests/security-hardening.test.ts tests/security-p0-regression.test.ts tests/oauth-security.test.ts tests/ssrf-security.test.ts tests/cache-keys.test.ts tests/engine-static.test.ts tests/frontend-xss.test.ts tests/config-parity.test.ts tests/recommendation-and-search.test.ts tests/multi-entity-recommendation.test.ts tests/release-p0-p1-gate.test.ts tests/beta-freeze-hardening.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 && npm run test:beta
scripts.test:beta: pnpm --dir player exec vitest run --root .. tests/access-store.test.ts tests/access-mode.test.ts tests/access-invite.test.ts tests/radar-persistence.test.ts tests/content-policy-production.test.ts tests/release-deployed-verification.test.ts tests/backend-beta-security.test.ts tests/backend-beta-runtime.test.ts tests/backend-beta-recommend.test.ts tests/backend-beta-release.test.ts tests/backend-beta-artifact.test.ts tests/backend-beta-mv-catalog.test.ts tests/backend-beta-identity.test.ts tests/release-followup-identity.test.ts tests/release-followup-data.test.ts tests/release-followup-package.test.ts tests/release-followup-observability.test.ts tests/release-followup-stream.test.ts --maxWorkers=1
scripts.test:security: pnpm --dir player exec vitest run --root .. tests/security-route-hardening.test.ts tests/security.test.ts tests/security-hardening.test.ts tests/security-p0-regression.test.ts tests/oauth-security.test.ts tests/ssrf-security.test.ts tests/engine-static.test.ts tests/frontend-xss.test.ts tests/config-parity.test.ts tests/release-p0-p1-gate.test.ts tests/beta-freeze-hardening.test.ts
scripts.test:recommend: pnpm --dir player exec vitest run --root .. tests/recommendation-and-search.test.ts tests/multi-entity-recommendation.test.ts
